# viettelcloud_lb_l7_policy (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud Load Balancer L7 Policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Policies of one listener share its positions. Create them in position order
# with depends_on, because a policy created at a position can shift the
# policies after it.
resource "viettelcloud_lb_l7_policy" "redirect_prefix" {
  listener    = { id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" }
  name        = "redirect-to-https"
  description = "Redirect HTTP to HTTPS"
  action      = "REDIRECT_PREFIX"
  position    = 1

  redirect_prefix    = "https://example.com"
  redirect_http_code = 301
}

resource "viettelcloud_lb_l7_policy" "redirect_server_group" {
  listener    = { id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" }
  name        = "forward-to-app-pool"
  description = "Forward requests to app server group"
  action      = "REDIRECT_TO_SERVER_GROUP"
  position    = 2

  redirect_server_group = { id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002" }

  depends_on = [viettelcloud_lb_l7_policy.redirect_prefix]
}

resource "viettelcloud_lb_l7_policy" "reject" {
  listener    = { id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" }
  name        = "block-traffic"
  description = "Reject matching requests"
  action      = "REJECT"
  position    = 3

  depends_on = [viettelcloud_lb_l7_policy.redirect_server_group]
}

resource "viettelcloud_lb_l7_policy" "redirect_url" {
  listener    = { id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" }
  name        = "redirect-to-external-url"
  description = "Redirect to maintenance page"
  action      = "REDIRECT_TO_URL"
  position    = 4

  redirect_url       = "https://maintenance.example.com"
  redirect_http_code = 302

  depends_on = [viettelcloud_lb_l7_policy.reject]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) Action of the L7 policy: REJECT, REDIRECT_TO_SERVER_GROUP (or REDIRECT_TO_POOL), REDIRECT_TO_URL, or REDIRECT_PREFIX.
- `listener` (Attributes) Listener that owns the L7 policy. Changing the listener replaces the policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--listener))
- `name` (String) Name of the L7 policy.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of the L7 policy. Omitting it preserves the backend value; set it to an empty string to clear it.
- `position` (Number) Position of the L7 policy within the listener.
- `redirect_http_code` (Number) HTTP response code for URL or prefix redirects (e.g. 301, 302). Omitting it keeps the code in effect, or uses 302. Not allowed for other actions.
- `redirect_prefix` (String) Prefix to redirect requests to. Required when action is REDIRECT_PREFIX, and not allowed for other actions.
- `redirect_server_group` (Attributes) Server group to redirect requests to. Required when action is REDIRECT_TO_SERVER_GROUP (or REDIRECT_TO_POOL), and not allowed for other actions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--redirect_server_group))
- `redirect_url` (String) URL to redirect requests to. Required when action is REDIRECT_TO_URL, and not allowed for other actions.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the L7 policy was created (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) L7 policy ID (UUID).
- `provisioning_status` (String) Provisioning status of the L7 policy.
- `rule_count` (Number) Number of rules associated with the L7 policy.
- `status` (String) Operational status of the L7 policy.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the L7 policy was last updated (RFC3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an L7 policy by ID.
terraform import viettelcloud_lb_l7_policy.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
```
